verdict.rationale: ROS 2 supports Gazebo simulation (ros2-docs-16) and rosbag recording/playback (ros2-docs-17, ros2-docs-23, ros2-docs-39) which together enable testing against simulated/recorded data instead of live production systems, and separate ROS domains/DDS partitioning could isolate test traffic. However there is no explicit first-party guidance framing a dedicated 'sandbox vs production' workflow or environment isolation for AI-native testing. missing for 10: explicit sandbox/staging environment documentation, guidance on isolating test data from production ROS graphs, AI-agent-specific test harness integration, independent corroboration of safe sandbox testing practice.
